name: Parent Advice
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred responsibility of parents to instruct and guide their children in the fear of the Lord, as seen in commands to honor parents and to embrace their instruction (Exodus 20:12; Proverbs 1:8; Proverbs 4:1). Children are portrayed as a divine heritage and reward from God (Psalms 127:3), underscoring the value of nurturing them with God’s commandments held deeply in the heart (Deuteronomy 6:6). Additionally, the discipline of the Lord, reflected in parental correction, is to be received without resentment, recognizing its role in godly growth (Proverbs 3:11).
